our_interpretation: Costs means undiscounted lifetime cash interest, with the percentage increase measured against original lifetime interest.
Hold principal and original tenor constant when comparing hypothetical replacement bonds with their original terms.

criteria.contradiction_condition: A reproducible calculation using matching principal amounts, original terms and September 29, 2026 replacement yields places either result outside its stated rounding interval.
